posterFile.retrievalMethod: Unauthenticated ordinary HTTPS GET from the official repository bitstream; no login, payment or access-control bypass.

visualReview.imageSizeMeaning: Illustrated sizes are proportional to each fish maximum length (Lmax), not abundance.

rightsAndScope.decision: Keep poster image and all species-level poster rows out of the public app pending item-specific reuse rights, independent taxonomic review and waterbody-scope review.

limits: The poster describes a historical 2020-2022 source window and is not current-presence evidence.
Its layout is explicitly not a ranking; Lmax illustration sizes do not indicate abundance.
No item-specific reuse terms were found on the repository item page.
An exact locality query returning zero is not evidence of fish absence and can miss spelling variants or records without that locality text.
No coordinates, fishing access, catchability, legal rules or safety claims were added.
